verdict.rationale: Sketch has a published pricing page that lists plan features such as SSO, SCIM provisioning, permissions groups and project archiving, plus a 30-day free trial. Its docs say developers can be invited to inspect designs for free, which signals a free seat type. The AI page states AI use has 'no tokens to buy, no extra tiers, and no add-ons', so AI gating is clear. However, the evidence shows no actual prices, tier names, or which features belong to which tier. Missing for 10: explicit price points and tier names, a defined seat-type breakdown (editor vs viewer vs guest costs), a per-tier feature/gating matrix, and independent corroboration of pricing clarity.
